title: ZeroDivisionError when calculating average on empty batch
body:
Version: v1.2.0

Steps to reproduce:
1. Initialize BatchCalculator with items=[]
2. Call calculator.compute_average()

Error traceback:
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero in stats.py line 45

title: CLI crashes on startup with invalid config file
body: Whenever I launch the CLI with --config custom.yaml it crashes immediately with a JSONDecodeError.

title: Memory leak during long-running background worker process
body:
Version: 3.4.1
OS: Debian 12

Steps:
1. Start worker service: systemctl start worker
2. Stream 100k messages through queue
3. Memory consumption grows from 200MB to 6GB over 4 hours.

Logs show no unhandled exceptions but heap snapshot reveals unbounded list growth in dispatcher.py.

title: Add support for YAML configuration files in addition to JSON
body: Currently the config parser only accepts .json files. It would be much more user-friendly to support .yaml and .yml files using PyYAML or ruamel.yaml.

title: Support asynchronous streaming responses in client SDK
body: We would like an async iterator method like `client.stream_events()` so we can consume tokens in real time instead of waiting for the full response payload.

title: Add prometheus metrics endpoint for monitoring
body: Proposal to expose an HTTP `/metrics` endpoint with counters for requests_total and latency histograms for integration with Grafana / Prometheus.

title: How to configure custom SSL certificates behind an enterprise proxy?
body: I am trying to run the client behind a corporate proxy that performs SSL inspection. Where in the configuration can I specify a custom CA bundle path (e.g. ca-bundle.crt)?

title: Recommended batch size for GPU inference on RTX 4090
body: Hi team, what is the recommended batch size when running batch predictions on a single RTX 4090 with 24GB VRAM? Is 32 optimal or does 64 fit comfortably?

title: Fix broken hyperlink in Getting Started guide
body: The link to the 'Authentication Tutorial' in docs/getting-started.md line 24 points to a 404 URL (https://docs.example.com/auth-v1 instead of /auth-v2).

title: Update Docker deployment documentation for version 2.0
body: The README and docs/docker.md still reference docker-compose syntax from v1.x which was deprecated. The environment variable names also need to be updated to match the new prefix.
